verdict.rationale: INPI is an IP-office service platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The only programmatic signal is a probe showing data.inpi.fr returns HTTP 403 to keyless requests, which says nothing about MCP support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
